title: WeatherMan - AI Weather Social Bot
description: Automated social media bot that generates stunning isometric 3D city weather visualizations using AI and posts them across Instagram, X, and TikTok.
longDescription: WeatherMan is an automated social media bot that creates beautiful isometric 3D city weather images using Google's Gemini AI and real-time weather data. The bot automatically posts to Instagram, X (Twitter), and TikTok with timezone-aware scheduling. Features include multi-city configuration via YAML, modular platform architecture, and GitHub Actions automation for hands-free operation at minimal cost.
